name: settings-yaml-tag-directives
about: G8：pilotdeck.yaml 带两条 %TAG 指令（只用了其中一条）、核心 schema 下的已知标签 !!binary / !!timestamp / !!omap 与本地标签时 update_settings。基线 directives.js toString 只写出内容里用到的 %TAG；用过 !!omap 后它进了 schema.tags，新建的中间层也成为 !!omap。
config:
%TAG !a! tag:a.example,2000:
%TAG !b! tag:b.example,2000:
---
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          thinking:
            state: enabled
            efforts: [low, medium, high]
            format: openai
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
legacyTagged: !a!thing value
legacyBin: !!binary aGVsbG8=
legacyWhen: !!timestamp 2002-12-14
legacyOmap: !!omap
  - a: 1
legacyLocal: !local x
